name: Quota Priority Rotator (即将刷新优先)
description: 账号配额自动两阶段优先级轮换插件：满额（100%）账号优先轮询调度；所有账号降至99%及以下时，自动转为“即将刷新优先（Reset-soon first）”，全力优先消耗重置倒计时最短的账号；0%周限或短窗耗尽账号自动避让。 / Two-stage quota rotator for CLIProxyAPI: Full-capacity (100%) accounts round-robin first; when all accounts fall to <=99%, automatically activates Reset-Soon First routing to drain accounts closest to their weekly reset. Exhausted (0%) or 5h short-window exhausted accounts are strictly bypassed.
author: daodeqing
